This plot is small, just a small piece near the house, and I grow maize here every year like my father did. I do not have cash for the fertilizer bag — one bag is too much for this little plot anyway, and the cooperative often comes late. I will put the manure from my cattle and goats on it, use my own seed I saved from last harvest, and my wife and children will help me weed. I have no pump and no river close, so I wait for the rains like everyone in my village.
